errors.text_span: Стълбовидната диаграма представя разпределението на процентите на различни експерти във всяко от 23-те слоя на смес от експерти (MoE) на няколко експерта за различни модели.
errors.evidence: The description treats the two separate subplots in the figure (titled 'Text' and 'Image') as a single chart, failing to acknowledge that there are two distinct bar charts presented side-by-side.

errors.text_span: Най-късото стълбище се издига от 0% до 25%, а най-високото стълбище достига до 100%.
errors.evidence: The term 'стълбище' (staircase) is an incorrect and confusing word choice for a bar segment. Furthermore, the description of the 'shortest' and 'highest' segments is vague; stating the highest reaches 100% is trivially true for all bars in a 100% stacked chart and thus uninformative.
The description incorrectly states that the bars are grouped ('групирани'), when they are clearly stacked ('натрупани').

errors.text_span: едната е със засенчена червено, показваща процента на "Expert 1", а другата е със засенчена оранжево, показваща процента на "Expert 3".
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps colors to categories. It states that 'Expert 1' is red and 'Expert 3' is orange. According to the legend, 'Expert 1' is blue, 'Expert 3' is green, 'Expert 4' is red, and 'Expert 2' is orange.
The description fails to mention all four experts shown in the legend. It only references 'Expert 1' and 'Expert 3', completely omitting 'Expert 2' and 'Expert 4'.

errors.text_span: Всяко стълбище представлява пропорцията на съответния експерт в дадения слой, като дължината на стълбището кодира показания процент.
errors.evidence: The repeated use of the incorrect term 'стълбище' (staircase) instead of 'сегмент' (segment) or 'част от стълб' (part of a bar) makes the description awkward and unclear.
The description fails to mention that the figure contains two separate plots, one titled 'Text' and the other 'Image'. It attempts to describe a single, non-existent chart.

errors.text_span: Der Balken für Layer 1 ist blau und erzeichnet 75 %.
errors.evidence: The description fundamentally misunderstands the chart's structure. It describes the charts as simple bar charts, when they are 100% stacked bar charts. For example, it states 'The bar for Layer 1 is blue', but in reality, each bar is composed of multiple colored segments representing different experts, and all bars have a total height of 100%.
For the 'Text' plot, the blue segment (Expert 1) for layer 1 is approximately 85%, not 75%. For the 'Image' plot, there is no blue segment for layer 1.
The description hallucinates colors. The legend includes blue, orange, green, and red. 'Gelb' (yellow) and 'Rosa' (pink) are not present in the chart or legend. This error is repeated three times.

errors.text_span: Die Balken für Layer 3 bis 7 sind alle ungefähr 11 % hoch.
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. All bars are 100% stacked bars, meaning their total height is 100%, not 11%.

errors.text_span: Der Balken für Layer 9 ist blau und erzeichnet 15 %.
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. In the 'Image' plot, the bar for layer 9 is 100% blue. In the 'Text' plot, the bar for layer 9 contains no blue. The value of 15% is incorrect in either case.

errors.text_span: Die Balken für Layer 11 bis 17 sind alle ungefähr 13 % hoch.
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. All bars are 100% stacked bars, meaning their total height is 100%, not 13%.

errors.text_span: Der Balken für Layer 19 ist blau und erzeichnet 17 %.
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. In the 'Image' plot, the blue segment for layer 19 is approximately 80%. In the 'Text' plot, there is no blue. The value of 17% is incorrect in either case.

errors.text_span: Die Balken für Layer 21 und 23 sind alle ungefähr 15 % hoch.
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. All bars are 100% stacked bars, meaning their total height is 100%, not 15%.

The description fails to explain the mapping of colors to experts as defined in the legend (e.g., blue represents Expert 1, orange represents Expert 2, etc.). This was an explicit requirement of the prompt.
